source: Source: AAA Thanksgiving travel forecast, Nov 2026 (travel Nov 24–30).

scenes.text: Whoa! $800... just to fly home for turkey?!
scenes.say: Whoa! Eight hundred dollars... just to fly home for turkey?!
scenes.head: $800 FOR TURKEY?

scenes.text: That's AAA's average domestic round-trip this Thanksgiving. Up 17% from last year.
scenes.say: That's triple-A's average domestic round trip this Thanksgiving. Up seventeen percent from last year.
scenes.head: UP 17%

scenes.text: And still... 81.5 million Americans are traveling.
scenes.say: And still... eighty-one and a half million Americans are traveling.
scenes.head: 81.5 MILLION TRAVELERS

scenes.text: Wait a second... how? 72.9 million drive. Only 5.96 million fly.
scenes.say: Wait a second... how? Seventy-two point nine million drive. Only five point nine six million fly.
scenes.head: CAR VS PLANE

scenes.text: Heh. So that's the trick. Twelve drivers for every flyer.
scenes.say: Heh. So that's the trick. Twelve drivers for every flyer.
scenes.head: 12 TO 1
